labels: OWNER 5554263833 item 1 -- canonical L5 fields vs PMUS vs Gemini; MATCH = same semantics through the adapter, CONVENTION = adapter rule not a model fact, MISMATCH = semantic difference the model never saw, GAP = not verifiable from retained evidence

rows.pmus: YES/NO on a team/side; no natural Up
rows.note: the model predicts a relation, never a side; open side = cheaper touch, ties YES (shared rule on both venues)
coarser Gemini grid floors the complement bound by up to 1c; band identical to PMUS q1 band

rows.pmus: penny contracts (0.01-0.06 filled); behavioral unit = first fill
rows.gemini: whole contracts, $1 payout; minimum order size NOT in retained evidence (prints 100-500)
rows.note: a q=1 Gemini unit costs $0.20-0.80 -- it cannot fit under the PMUS <=$0.05 filled cap; a Gemini probe needs its OWN money cap (owner decision), never a raised PMUS cap

rows.l5: fixed 5-minute expiry; TTE buckets drive 27% of actions <5m
rows.pmus: no fixed clock (game end) -> coarsest bucket tte>10m always
rows.gemini: fixed expiry stamped in ticker; MIN_TTE 105s, entry <=300s, stop 25s before
rows.note: Gemini is CLOSER to L5 than PMUS on the TTE axis; PMUS collapses the TTE dimension

rows.l5: exact shares, signed residual, avg-cost pair
rows.pmus: same arithmetic in exact Decimal; residual in behavioral units, cap 3
rows.gemini: same arithmetic (L5Inventory shared); residual settles at expiry within minutes
rows.note: hold DURATION differs: Gemini residual is forced to settlement in <=5 min, PMUS holds for hours

rows.pmus: bbo YES bid/ask; bid qty only (ask qty null in samples); spreads 0.005-0.05
rows.gemini: /v1/book both sides with sizes; entry spread p50 0.11; depth p50 ~297/266
rows.note: Gemini spreads are ~5x wider than PMUS at entry; a touch-join fill needs a taker crossing that spread

rows.pmus: sharesTraded delta + recorder WS tape (side inferred)
rows.gemini: /v1/trades with buy/sell side; two-sided flow in 49.2% of windows (MLB 82.5%)
rows.note: flow density, not schema, is the transfer constraint

rows.l5: maker joins, taker share rises to 58% <30s TTE
rows.gemini: maker-only in the vendored engine; taker path not vendored
rows.note: taker completion economics on Gemini are unknown (taker fee not vendored); stays shadow on both venues

rows.gemini: maker fee ceil-cent 0.0175*q*p*(1-p) COUNTED against edge; rebates/rewards never counted
rows.note: Gemini's positive maker fee makes the hard bound 2c/pair tighter than PMUS (0.48 surplus -> 0.49 vs 0.51 complement)

rows.pmus: POSITION_RESOLUTION activity; realized only from afterPosition.realized
rows.gemini: 60s rolling RFR at expiry; authority = settlement audit; REPLAY uses a mid proxy (>=0.80 UP / <=0.20 DOWN / else AMBIGUOUS)
rows.note: every Gemini replay P&L is THEORETICAL; only the venue's settlement rows may ever be labeled realized

rows.pmus: probe decision log + recorder tape on Railway
rows.gemini: collector tapes (bbo) + public trades; live public book
rows.note: Gemini retained tape covers 400 symbols with quotes AND prints over 4 days (118 entry-eligible windows)

rows.gemini: separate authority required (active orders + session cancel); nothing shared with PMUS
rows.note: must be built per venue; one venue's 500 must not block the other's reconcile

rows.pmus: one-market execution lock; $0.05 filled per market; 3 markets/campaign (R1)
rows.gemini: own lock + own caps via the shared allocator; DISARMED (cap 0) until authorized
rows.note: allocator refuses double reservation per (venue, market); only the TOTAL daily-loss stop freezes both venues
